name: NIST SP 800-53
scopeNote: NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 has ~1000 controls across 20 families and is applied via a tailored baseline (Low/Moderate/High). This catalog is NOT the full baseline — it is the subset of controls for which application SAST/SCA/secrets/IaC scanning provides direct or supporting evidence (primarily the SI, SC, AC, IA, AU, RA, SA, and CM families). Controls outside this subset (PE physical, PS personnel, CP contingency, etc.) require other evidence and are out of scope for a code scan.

controls.title: Access Enforcement
controls.summary: Enforce approved authorizations for logical access to information and system resources.

controls.title: Information Flow Enforcement
controls.summary: Enforce approved authorizations for controlling the flow of information, including outbound requests.

controls.title: Least Privilege
controls.summary: Employ the principle of least privilege for users and processes.

controls.title: Session Termination
controls.summary: Automatically terminate user sessions after defined conditions.

controls.title: Event Logging
controls.summary: Log security-relevant events with sufficient content for after-the-fact investigation.

controls.title: Content of Audit Records
controls.summary: Ensure audit records contain sufficient information and do not leak sensitive data.
evidenceExamples: Sensitive data in logs / log injection findings

controls.title: Protection of Audit Information
controls.summary: Protect audit information and tools from unauthorized access, modification, and deletion.

controls.title: Configuration Settings
controls.summary: Establish and enforce secure configuration settings for system components.

controls.title: Least Functionality
controls.summary: Configure systems to provide only essential capabilities; disable unused functions and ports.

controls.title: Identification and Authentication (Organizational Users)
controls.summary: Uniquely identify and authenticate organizational users and processes.

controls.title: Authenticator Management
controls.summary: Manage authenticators (passwords, keys, tokens) securely and do not embed them in code.
implementationChecklist: Store secrets in a managed vault

controls.title: Cryptographic Module Authentication
controls.summary: Use approved cryptographic mechanisms for authentication.

controls.title: Vulnerability Monitoring and Scanning
controls.summary: Scan for vulnerabilities, analyze results, and remediate.

controls.title: System Development Life Cycle
controls.summary: Manage the system using a secure development lifecycle that integrates security.

controls.title: Developer Testing and Evaluation
controls.summary: Developers perform security testing including static analysis during development.

controls.title: Development Process, Standards, and Tools
controls.summary: Apply a documented development process with security standards and tools such as static analysis.
implementationChecklist: Adopt a secure development process with tooling
evidenceExamples: Static analysis tooling in the pipeline

controls.title: Denial of Service Protection
controls.summary: Protect against or limit the effects of denial-of-service events.

controls.title: Transmission Confidentiality and Integrity
controls.summary: Protect the confidentiality and integrity of transmitted information.

controls.title: Cryptographic Protection
controls.summary: Implement approved cryptography for the protection of information.
implementationChecklist: Use approved algorithms and key sizes

controls.title: Session Authenticity
controls.summary: Protect the authenticity of communications sessions.

controls.title: Protection of Information at Rest
controls.summary: Protect the confidentiality and integrity of information at rest.

controls.title: Flaw Remediation
controls.summary: Identify, report, and correct system flaws; track remediation to closure.

controls.title: Malicious Code Protection
controls.summary: Detect and eradicate malicious code.

controls.title: Software, Firmware, and Information Integrity
controls.summary: Verify the integrity of software, firmware, and information.
implementationChecklist: Verify integrity of software and updates

controls.title: Information Input Validation
controls.summary: Check the validity of information inputs to prevent injection and malformed-data attacks.

controls.title: Error Handling
controls.summary: Generate error messages that do not reveal information exploitable by adversaries.
evidenceExamples: Verbose error / sensitive data in logs findings

controls.title: Information Output Filtering
controls.summary: Validate and filter information output to detect and prevent unexpected/dangerous content.

controls.title: Memory Protection
controls.summary: Implement controls to protect system memory from unauthorized code execution.
